cards.target: just how versatile stadiums can be
cards.meaning: 体育场可以有多么多用途(just how 表强调程度)
cards.sentence: The amphitheatre of Arles in southwest France, with a capacity of 25,000 spectators, is perhaps the best example of just how versatile stadiums can be.
cards.focus: just how versatile stadiums can be
cards.title: 体育场的过去、现在与未来
cards.translation: 法国西南部阿尔勒的圆形竞技场可容纳25,000名观众，也许是最能说明体育场用途究竟有多灵活的例子。
cards.note: 这里的 just 不是「刚刚」,也不是「仅仅/只是」。just how + 形容词(或副词)用来强调 程度,意思是「究竟有多么......」「恰恰说明有多么......」。本句:The amphitheatre of Arles ... is perhaps the best example of just how versatile stadiums can be。拆开看:阿尔勒圆形剧场或许 是最好的例子,用来说明体育场可以有多么灵活、多么多用途。比较:just now(刚刚); just a tourist(只是一名游客);just how versatile / important / difficult ...(强调程度, 本句用法)。也可以说 This shows just how adaptable the building is。versatile 的独立释义见文 末第 126 条。
cards.collocations: just how + adj. + 主语 + 动词 ∙ an example of just how + adj. + n. + can be
cards.related: versatile(见第 126 条) ∙ flexibility(见第 59 条)
cards.originalRef: C17 T1 P2 · 笔记第 25 条

cards.meaning: 卓越的音响效果(建筑声学效果)
cards.sentence: It has endured the centuries and is currently considered one of the world’s prime sites for opera, thanks to its outstanding acoustics.
cards.title: 体育场的过去、现在与未来
cards.translation: 它历经数个世纪，如今凭借出色的音响效果，被认为是世界上最重要的歌剧演出场地之一。
cards.note: acoustics 在本句指一座建筑物的音响效果、听音条件,也就是建筑声学意义上的声音表现, 不是「声学设备」,也不是泛泛的「声音」。outstanding acoustics = 出色的音响效果。语法 要注意三点。第一,表示厅堂或剧场的音响效果时,acoustics 用复数形式, 常说 The hall has outstanding acoustics 或 The acoustics are excellent。第二, 若指「声学」这门学科,词形仍是 acoustics, 但常作单数看待:Acoustics is the study of sound。第三, 不带 s 的 acoustic 是形容词(acoustic design 声学设计), 与本句名词用法不同。原文 thanks to its outstanding acoustics, 说明维罗纳能成为一流歌剧场地,正是因为音响效果出色。
cards.collocations: outstanding / excellent / poor acoustics ꞏ thanks to its outstanding acoustics
cards.related: the world’s prime sites for opera(见第 45 条) ∙ acoustic (adj.)

cards.sentence: The site evolved in a similar way to Arles and was progressively filled with buildings from the Middle Ages until the 19th century, variously used as houses, a salt depot and a prison.
cards.title: 体育场的过去、现在与未来
cards.translation: 这个场地以与阿尔勒类似的方式演变，从中世纪到19世纪逐渐被建筑填满，先后用作住宅、盐仓和监狱。
cards.note: depot 是仓库、储藏处;a salt depot 即存放盐的仓库, 中文可说「盐仓」。原文是 variously used as houses, a salt depot and a prison。第 21 题题干是 including the storage of ______,指令为 Choose ONE WORD ONLY。语法槽位:the storage of + 被储存的东西,因此填 salt(储存盐)。不能填 depot:storage of depot 变成「储存仓 库」,语义不通;salt depot 又是两个词, 超过一字限制。本题依据就是 a salt depot 与题干 the storage of 的对应,不是「盐用来防腐、 保存」之类的背景知识——本文此题并未讨论防腐。完整推理见文末错题复盘。
cards.collocations: a salt depot ꞏ a depot for + 储存物 ∙ the storage of salt
cards.related: the storage of salt ꞏ the remains of(见第 125 条)
cards.originalRef: C17 T1 P2 · 笔记第 52 条
cards.origin: 个人学习笔记 · 原句已对照本地剑雅材料 · 译文为学习辅助
cards.feedback: 第21题为什么填 salt？结合原文 a salt depot 讲清楚。
cards.grammar: the storage of 后面填被储存的东西；a salt depot 是盐仓，因此此题只填 salt，不能填 depot。

cards.meaning: 被并入、纳入某事物之中
cards.sentence: It is now a market square with [22 ____] and homes incorporated into the remains of the Roman amphitheatre.
cards.title: 体育场的过去、现在与未来
cards.translation: 它如今是一个集市广场，[第22题空格]和住宅被融入罗马圆形竞技场的遗迹之中。
cards.note: 本条为后补,便于核对。incorporate A into B = 把 A 并入 B。摘要第 22 题题干是 with shops and homes incorporated into the remains of the Roman amphitheatre, 用这个短语改写 C 段 the ruins ... remain embedded in the various shops and residences。两句话 描述同一事实,语序相反:原文强调遗迹嵌在店铺住宅里, 题干强调店铺住宅被纳入遗迹之中。参见第 57、125 条。
cards.collocations: be incorporated into sth. ꞏ shops and homes incorporated into the remains of ...
cards.related: remain embedded in(见第 57 条) ∙ the remains of sth.(见第 125 条) ∙ the ruins of(见第 56 条)

cards.meaning: 用途多样的,适应性强的
cards.sentence: The amphitheatre of Arles in southwest France, with a capacity of 25,000 spectators, is perhaps the best example of just how versatile stadiums can be.
cards.title: 体育场的过去、现在与未来
cards.translation: 法国西南部阿尔勒的圆形竞技场可容纳25,000名观众，也许是最能说明体育场用途究竟有多灵活的例子。
cards.note: 本条为后补,单独释义,与第 25 条交叉引用。versatile 指同一事物可有多种用途或易于适 应新用途,不是「性格多才多艺」的那一层必须用在人身上——建筑物、 工具也可以说 versatile。摘要开头也有 The Roman stadiums of Europe have proved very versatile。just how versatile stadiums can be 的强调用法见第 25 条, 不要把那里的 just 理解成「刚刚」或「仅仅」。名词 versatility, 近义 flexible(见第 59 条 flexibility)。
cards.collocations: just how versatile stadiums / sth. can be ꞏ a versatile building / design
cards.related: just how versatile stadiums can be(见第 25 条) ∙ the flexibility(见第 59 条) ∙ multi-functionality(见第 90 条)
